Android keeps items here for about 30 days, then deletes them for good. Tap to select, then restore or delete.
Svitlyna needs access to your photos and videos to show them. Only photos and videos: no other files, contacts or location.
Svitlyna has no internet access: nothing ever leaves your phone.

Optional. With it, moving to the trash, deleting for good and future edits happen without Android\'s confirmation window each time (Svitlyna still asks before deleting for good). It is still access to photos and videos only.
Photos are sent as copies with the location removed; your originals stay as they are. Videos and some formats (HEIC, GIF…) can\'t be cleaned yet: you\'ll be asked before sending them.
A notification: tap it to open the screenshot, or use "Without bars" and "Text". No picture of the screenshot in it, and on the lock screen only "Svitlyna". Your screenshot itself is never changed.
Always save a copy without bars
Right after each screenshot, with no tap. The original stays next to it. In full-screen apps (video, games) there is no status bar, so the top of the picture would be cut: use the button instead.
Save without bars or copy its text. Tap to open.
Copy its text. Tap to open.
Next to the screenshot, with the same date. Tap to open.
Couldn\'t save a copy without bars
This photo has a location: the copy you send won\'t. No other metadata goes either.
The copy you send has no metadata (no location, camera or dates).
Looking for personal details in the text…
No card or phone numbers, e-mail, IBAN, car plates or addresses found in the text. Check faces and places yourself.
Tap a found detail to show or hide it. Drag a finger to black out any other area; tap it to remove.
The text wasn\'t checked (stopped, took over a minute, or couldn\'t be read). Look the photo over yourself or black out areas by hand.
Only the top part of this very long screenshot was checked.
Offers to move old screenshots to the trash (Android asks to confirm; restorable for about 30 days). "Keep" in the viewer stops a screenshot from being offered.
